news.headline: Wall Street sells off: S&P 500 -1.9%, Nasdaq -2.5%
news.what_happened: US equities fell sharply in the latest session, with tech leading losses. Hang Seng (-1.2%) and Nikkei (-1.2%) are also lower this morning.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off global cue points to a weak open for Indian large caps and IT; Nasdaq drop >1% is negative for IT services. Defensives relatively better.

news.headline: Crude eases: WTI -0.8% to $85, Brent ~-1%
news.what_happened: WTI settled near $85.0/bbl and Brent near $91.5, both lower on the day.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude trims input costs for airlines (jet fuel) and paints (crude derivatives); mildly negative for upstream/OMC.

news.headline: Nifty closed +0.58% at 25,291 yesterday; rupee steady near 93.9
news.what_happened: Nifty ended higher while global cues turned negative overnight. USD/INR stable around 93.9; US 10Y yield at ~5.12%.
news.why_it_matters: Gap-down risk at open; entries should wait for the first 15-30 minutes to settle. High US yields keep FII flows cautious.
